task.title: Candidate pool BFF routes contract (additive §17.3)
task.summary_zh: 依 SD §8/§17.3 與既有 services/control-plane/specs/agora/candidate_pool.schema.json + design-closure A2(candidate_scoring_recipe.schema.json + winner_branch.default.json)補上 candidate pool 的 BFF 路由契約(目前 agora_v1*.openapi.yaml 皆無):candidate pool/member/discussion/monitoring CRUD + score/review endpoint。score 必須由 A2 recipe 計算(score_components 對齊 recipe)、rejected 候選保留為 negative example。以 additive 方式加入(優先延伸 v1.3 或新增 v1.4 fragment,依 repo 慣例;不得改動或重雜湊 frozen v1/v1.1/v1.2)。重用既有 candidate_pool.schema.json,不自創欄位/route。 【有疑問先 STOP 開 blocker,Agora 不下單】
acceptance: candidate pool/score/review §17.3 路由到位且重用 candidate_pool.schema + A2 recipe;score 由 recipe 算;frozen v1/v1.1/v1.2 + bundle_index sha256 不變;additive

review_notes_zh: 審查通過：v1.4 以 additive OpenAPI fragment + v5 schemas 補上 candidate pool/list/get/create、score get/post、member list/get、member review、pool/member discussions、monitoring list/add/remove；CandidateScoreResult.components 含 A2 component contract 核心欄位；四個 score 欄位 raw_score/penalty_score/evidence_confidence/effective_score 為 required；CandidateMemberReview 保留 negative_example_tags；capability_manifest_v1_4.json 有 no_order_route_proof；v1/v1.1/v1.2/v1.3 與 candidate_pool.schema.json 未改。驗證：python3 custom parse/hash/route consistency check；python3 -m pytest scripts/test_agora_v1_2_bundle.py services/control-plane/tests/agora/test_winner_branch_e2e_v13.py services/control-plane/tests/agora/test_agora_isolation_matrix.py（151 passed）。非阻塞 note：部分說明文字仍用 rawScore/penaltyScore/evidenceConfidence/effectiveScore camelCase，但 schema required 欄位為 snake_case。

handoffs.message: Please review the v1.4 additive candidate pool BFF contract. Key review points: (1) all §17.3 routes present — pool CRUD, score/review, member CRUD, pool+member discussions, monitoring watchlist; (2) CandidateScoreResult.components align to A2 CandidateScoringRecipe component contract (component_id, category, transform, direction, weight, contribution, missing_policy, evidence_refs); (3) score endpoint always returns all 4 score fields (raw_score, penalty_score, evidence_confidence, effective_score); (4) rejected candidates preserved via negative_example_tags field in CandidateMemberReview; (5) no_order_route_proof enforced in capability_manifest_v1_4.json and repeated in OpenAPI descriptions; (6) v1/v1.1/v1.2/v1.3 not modified; (7) candidate_pool.schema.json reused by $ref with no field additions. Commit: fe00b665 on task/AG-XR-CP-001.

Codex review approved AG-XR-CP-001 at fe00b665. Verified v1.4 additive candidate pool contract, bundle hashes, manifest/OpenAPI route consistency, frozen v1-v1.3/candidate_pool untouched, A2 score component alignment, required score fields, negative_example_tags, and no_order_route_proof. Local validation: python3 parse/hash/route consistency check; python3 -m pytest scripts/test_agora_v1_2_bundle.py services/control-plane/tests/agora/test_winner_branch_e2e_v13.py services/control-plane/tests/agora/test_agora_isolation_matrix.py (151 passed). Owner Claude2 should finalize after PR flow.
